news.summary: Key TakeawaysByteDance, Alibaba and Tencent have reportedly ordered more than $35 billion of NVIDIA’s export-compliant chips, and export-control expert Chris McGuire says Chinese companies can also legally rent US-made AI compute from data centers abroad, or even in the US. news.title: Qualcomm Says December Won’t Be Its Biggest Quarter Anymore as Apple Walks Away
news.summary: Qualcomm has known for years that Apple would leave, and now the CFO says it will rewrite the company's calendar. Can automotive and AI data centers fill the gap before the next earnings report tests the story?

news.title: Siri AI's Biggest Upgrade Yet + John Ternus's First Apple Earnings Call
news.summary: Apple is finally bringing some of Siri's most ambitious AI capabilities to the iPhone. In this episode of Power On, Bloomberg's Mark Gurman and Vlad Savov break down the major changes coming with iOS 27.3, including Siri's new ability to control apps, carry out complex tasks and coordinate actions across multiple applications. They discuss how these improvements compare with AI agents from OpenAI and Meta, and why Apple still has a long way to go. Plus, Mark and Vlad analyze John Ternus's first earnings call as Apple's CEO, the company's strong iPhone sales, concerns about slowing growth and profit margins, and why more price increases could be coming. They also examine Apple's AI rollout in China and the privacy implications of new always-listening Apple Watch features. Have a question for Mark? Email us at poweron@bloomberg.net or join the Power On Discord Subscribe to the Power On Newsletter at https://www.bloomberg.com/poweron (Source: Bloomberg)
news.title_zh: Siri AI 迄今最大升級 + John Ternus 首次蘋果財報電話會議
news.summary_zh: 蘋果終於將 Siri 部分最具野心的 AI 功能帶入 iPhone。在這集 Power On 中，彭博社的 Mark Gurman 和 Vlad Savov 深入解析 iOS 27.3 即將推出的重大變化，包括 Siri 控制應用程式、執行複雜任務及跨多個應用程式協調行動的新能力。他們討論這些改進與 OpenAI 和 Meta 的 AI 代理相比如何，以及蘋果為何仍有很長的路要走。此外，Mark 和 Vlad 分析 John Ternus 身為蘋果執行長的首次財報電話會議、公司強勁的 iPhone 銷售、對成長放緩和利潤率的擔憂，以及為何可能還會漲價。他們還審視蘋果在中國的 AI 推出情況，以及新款持續聆聽 Apple Watch 功能的隱私意涵。有問題想問 Mark？請寄信至 poweron@bloomberg.net 或加入 Power On Discord 訂閱 Power On 電子報：https://www.bloomberg.com/poweron (來源：彭博社)

The company has cut daily token-based spending limits for some teams to as little as $25,...

news.title: Siri AI's Biggest Upgrade Yet + John Ternus's First Apple Earnings Call
news.summary: Apple is finally bringing some of Siri's most ambitious AI capabilities to the iPhone. In this episode of Power On, Bloomberg's Mark Gurman and Vlad Savov break down the major changes coming with iOS 27.3, including Siri's new ability to control apps, carry out complex tasks and coordinate actions across multiple applications. They discuss how these improvements compare with AI agents from OpenAI and Meta, and why Apple still has a long way to go. Plus, Mark and Vlad analyze John Ternus's first earnings call as Apple's CEO, the company's strong iPhone sales, concerns about slowing growth and profit margins, and why more price increases could be coming. They also examine Apple's AI rollout in China and the privacy implications of new always-listening Apple Watch features. Have a question for Mark? Email us at poweron@bloomberg.net or join the Power On Discord Subscribe to the Power On Newsletter at https://www.bloomberg.com/poweron (Source: Bloomberg)
news.title_zh: Siri AI 迄今最大升級 + John Ternus 首次蘋果財報電話會議
news.summary_zh: 蘋果終於將 Siri 部分最具野心的 AI 功能帶入 iPhone。在這集 Power On 中，彭博社的 Mark Gurman 和 Vlad Savov 深入解析 iOS 27.3 即將推出的重大變化，包括 Siri 控制應用程式、執行複雜任務及跨多個應用程式協調行動的新能力。他們討論這些改進與 OpenAI 和 Meta 的 AI 代理相比如何，以及蘋果為何仍有很長的路要走。此外，Mark 和 Vlad 分析 John Ternus 身為蘋果執行長的首次財報電話會議、公司強勁的 iPhone 銷售、對成長放緩和利潤率的擔憂，以及為何可能還會漲價。他們還審視蘋果在中國的 AI 推出情況，以及新款持續聆聽 Apple Watch 功能的隱私意涵。有問題想問 Mark？請寄信至 poweron@bloomberg.net 或加入 Power On Discord 訂閱 Power On 電子報：https://www.bloomberg.com/poweron (來源：彭博社)

news.title: Meta Has a Capex Guardrail That Few Talk About
news.summary: Meta is pouring well over $100B into AI, absorbing a massive legal charge, and watching its stock slide. One overlooked commitment from management gives this investor the nerve to keep buying while others fixate on the spending.
news.title_zh: Meta 擁有一個鮮少被提及的資本支出護欄
news.summary_zh: Meta 正投入遠超過 $100B 於 AI，承擔巨額法律費用，並眼看股價下滑。管理層一項被忽視的承諾，給了這位投資人繼續買進的勇氣，而其他人卻專注於支出。

news.title: Instagram brings Edits to desktop to take on CapCut
news.summary: The move puts Edits in more direct competition with ByteDance's CapCut, the video-editing app Meta sought to challenge when it launched Edits last year.
news.title_zh: Instagram 將 Edits 引入桌面端以對抗 CapCut
news.summary_zh: 此舉使 Edits 與字節跳動的 CapCut 形成更直接的競爭，後者是 Meta 去年推出 Edits 時所要挑戰的影片編輯應用程式。

news.title: Dan Ives Sees Cash Flow Rebound In MSFT, META, GOOGL, AMZN: Says AI Bubble Fears Thrown Out The Window
news.summary: Ives expects debt and equity financing, including at-the-market stock offerings, to decline by about 25% over the next year.
news.title_zh: 丹·艾夫斯看好 MSFT、META、GOOGL、AMZN 現金流反彈：稱 AI 泡沫恐慌已拋諸腦後
news.summary_zh: 艾夫斯預期未來一年債務和股權融資（包括市場股票發行）將下降約 25%。

news.title: Snap Tumbles 11% as User Growth Miss and Sluggish Ad Sales Overshadow Return to Profit; Pinterest Dips, Meta Holds Steady
news.summary: Snap finally made money, yet traders rushed for the exits. A quiet change in how the company counts its audience, plus a stubborn ad problem, has investors asking whether this turnaround is built on the right foundation.
news.title_zh: Snap 重挫 11%，用戶增長不及預期與疲軟廣告銷售蓋過轉盈；Pinterest 下跌，Meta 持平
news.summary_zh: Snap 終於賺錢了，交易員卻紛紛離場。該公司計算受眾方式的悄然變化，加上頑固的廣告問題，讓投資人質疑這波反轉是否建立在正確基礎上。

news.title: Meta buys AI coding startup Conductor
news.summary: Founded in 2024, Conductor developed an orchestration environment that allows software engineers to run multiple AI models in parallel.
news.title_zh: Meta 收購 AI 程式編寫新創公司 Conductor
news.summary_zh: 成立於 2024，Conductor 開發了一個編排環境，讓軟體工程師能夠並行執行多個 AI 模型。

news.title: Meta Paid 1.4 Times What Alphabet Did to Borrow in Euros
news.summary: A record order book should have given Meta the upper hand in its first euro bond sale. Yet buyers still priced it differently from its closest rival, and the reasons point to a deeper worry about funding AI.
news.title_zh: Meta 借歐元債的成本是 Alphabet 的 1.4 Times
news.summary_zh: 創紀錄的訂單簿本應讓 Meta 在其首次歐元債券發行中佔優。然而買家仍以不同於其最接近競爭對手的方式定價，原因指向對 AI 資金的更深層擔憂。

news.title: The Same $10,000 in Microsoft and Meta Could Produce Very Different Results by 2030
news.summary: Two AI giants, two completely different business models, and a five-year window that could leave one investor sitting on a much larger gain than the other. The gap between their bull and bear outcomes tells a story worth understanding before you commit a dollar to either.
news.title_zh: Microsoft 和 Meta 中相同的 $10,000 到 2030 可能產生截然不同的結果
news.summary_zh: 兩大 AI 巨頭，兩種完全不同的商業模式，以及一個五年窗口期，可能讓一位投資人獲得比另一位大得多的收益。在您投入一美元給任一家公司之前，了解它們牛市與熊市結果之間的差距所講述的故事，非常值得。

news.title: AI Agents: How Meta’s Muse, OpenAI’s Dots Work, What They Can Do, Safety Worries
news.summary: The tech industry has long been obsessed with the idea of creating a powerful digital assistant — whether it be a chatbot, a smart speaker or robot. Artificial intelligence offers the promise of realizing that goal.
news.title_zh: AI 代理：Meta 的 Muse、OpenAI 的 Dots 如何運作、能做什麼、安全疑慮
news.summary_zh: 科技業長期以來著迷於創造強大數位助理的想法 — 不管是聊天機器人、智慧喇叭還是機器人。人工智慧提供了實現該目標的希望。

news.title: The Deal With Meta & OpenAI Just Cost AMD $1.1 Billion
news.summary: The charge, equivalent to 66 cents per diluted share in AMD's earnings reconciliation, arrived as the chipmaker began shipping its new Instinct MI450 accelerators.
news.title_zh: 與 Meta 及 OpenAI 的交易讓 AMD 付出 $1.1 Billion 代價
news.summary_zh: 這項費用相當於 AMD 盈餘調節中每稀釋股份 66 美分，正值該晶片製造商開始出貨其新款 Instinct MI450 加速器之際。

news.title: Facebook expands Creator Fast Track program to Brazil
news.summary: The program offers incentives for creators not yet posting to Facebook, though the monetary incentives for Brazilian creators are significantly less than what the company offered in North America.
news.title_zh: Facebook 將創作者快速通道計畫擴展至巴西
news.summary_zh: 該計畫為尚未在 Facebook 發文的創作者提供激勵，雖然給巴西創作者的金錢激勵顯著少於公司在北美提供的金額。

news.title: TV Veteran Rich Latour To Head Meta's Branding Strategy
news.summary: Latour will run Meta's social media and content teams within the company's communications and public affairs division, reporting to division head Tucker Bounds.
news.title_zh: 資深電視人 Rich Latour 將掌管 Meta 品牌策略
news.summary_zh: Latour 將在公司傳播與公共事務部門內負責 Meta 的社群媒體與內容團隊，向部門主管 Tucker Bounds 回報。

news.title: AMD Tumbles 13%, NVIDIA Slides 7% as AI Regulation Fears Hit Chip Stocks; Intel Sinks 8%
news.summary: Political risk is outweighing strong earnings across the AI chip trade, and Advanced Micro Devices (NASDAQ:AMD) is taking the hardest hit. AMD stock is at $424.36, down 13% in morning trading. The slide comes days after the chipmaker reported a quarter that CEO Lisa Su said “was the largest and most profitable in our history.” […]
news.title_zh: AMD 暴跌 13%，NVIDIA 下滑 7%，AI 監管恐慌衝擊晶片股；英特爾下挫 8%
news.summary_zh: 政治風險在 AI 晶片交易中超越強勁盈餘，Advanced Micro Devices (NASDAQ:AMD) 受創最重。AMD 股價在 $424.36，早盤下跌 13%。此跌勢發生在晶片製造商公布財報幾天後，CEO 蘇姿豐表示該季「是我們歷史上最大且最獲利的一季。」 […]

news.title: Oracle Has Incredible News for Intel Stock Investors
news.summary: Intel's AI chip business has gained impressive momentum, and its collaboration with Oracle should help sustain this segment's impressive growth.
news.title_zh: Oracle 為 Intel 股票投資人帶來驚人消息
news.summary_zh: Intel 的 AI 晶片業務獲得令人印象深刻的動能，其與 Oracle 的合作應有助於維持該部門的驚人增長。

news.title: Lip-Bu Tan Put $20 Million Into Intel and Is Down $4.8 Million
news.summary: Intel's CEO bought again right after the stock's ugliest day in decades, and the market answered within 48 hours. His own filing and the company's cash warning raise a harder question than whether insiders know best.
news.title_zh: Lip-Bu Tan 投入 $20 Million 於 Intel，目前下跌 $4.8 Million
news.summary_zh: Intel 執行長在股價經歷數十年來最慘一天後再度買進，市場在 48 小時內做出反應。他個人的申報文件與公司的現金警示，引發比「內部人士是否最清楚」更棘手的問題。

news.title: AMD Sinks 13%, Bloom Energy Down 18% as Midterm “Seismic Shift” Deepens Chip Sell-Off
news.summary: Key TakeawaysAMD fell 13% today, with Intel and Bloom Energy also lower, on fears that Democrats’ midterm sweep will slow the AI data-center build-out. AMD had no news of its own, two days after a strong quarter and a forecast for 80%-plus revenue growth in 2027.
news.title_zh: AMD 下跌 13%，Bloom Energy 下跌 18%，中期選舉「劇變」加深晶片拋售潮
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要AMD 今日下跌 13%，英特爾和 Bloom Energy 也走低，市場擔心民主黨在中期選舉大勝將放緩 AI 資料中心建設。AMD 自身無消息，此前兩天剛發布強勁財報並預測 80% 以上營收增長，目標年份為 2027。

news.title: AMD Faces Nvidia Software Hurdle, While Intel Could Reclaim PC Market Share, Morningstar Says
news.summary: Morningstar senior analyst Brian Colello said AMD needs to strengthen its software capabilities to challenge Nvidia’s AI dominance.
news.title_zh: AMD 面臨 Nvidia 軟體障礙，而 Intel 可能奪回 PC 市場份額，Morningstar 指出
news.summary_zh: Morningstar 資深分析師 Brian Colello 表示 AMD 需加強軟體能力以挑戰 Nvidia 的 AI 霸主地位。

news.title: Better Foundry Stock: Taiwan Semiconductor vs. Intel
news.summary: The better foundry stock looks like a clear choice.
news.title_zh: 較佳晶圓代工股：台積電對決 Intel
news.summary_zh: 較佳的晶圓代工股看起來是明顯的選擇。

news.title: Arm Sinks 19% in a Week as Intel’s Warning Hits Chip Stocks. Is It a Buy?
news.summary: Key TakeawaysArm Holdings fell 19% in a week as Intel’s weak fourth-quarter outlook hit chip stocks. Intel blamed short supply of packaging substrates, a part Arm also needs for its own AGI CPU.
news.title_zh: Arm 一週下跌 19%，因 Intel 警示衝擊晶片股。值得買進嗎？
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要Arm Holdings 一週下跌 19%，因 Intel 第四季疲軟展望衝擊晶片股。Intel 歸咎封裝基板供應短缺，這也是 Arm 自家 AGI CPU 所需的零件。

news.title: Intel: I Warned Before The 40% Crash, Now I'm Bullish (Rating Upgrade)
news.summary: Intel Corporations's 40% correction resets valuation expectations, prompting an upgrade despite substantial 2027 investment requirements. More on INTC stock.
news.title_zh: Intel：我在 40% 暴跌前已發出警告，現看好（評級上調）
news.summary_zh: Intel Corporation 的 40% 回檔重設估值預期，儘管有龐大的 2027 投資需求，仍提升評級。更多 INTC 股票資訊。

news.title: Intel Sinks 39% in a Week on a Weak Outlook. Its CEO Bought $9.7 Million of Stock
news.summary: Key TakeawaysIntel shares fell 39% in the past week after a fourth-quarter revenue outlook well below expectations. CEO Lip-Bu Tan bought $9.
news.title_zh: Intel 因疲軟展望一週下跌 39%。其 CEO 買進 $9.7 Million 股票
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要Intel 股價在第四季營收展望遠低於預期後，過去一週下跌 39%。CEO Lip-Bu Tan 買進 $9。

news.title: TSMC Is Up 30% in a Year and 19% Off Its High: Take Profits, or Buy More?
news.summary: Key TakeawaysTSMC stock is up 30% in the past year but sits 19% below its October high, after chip stocks sold off on Lam Research’s and Intel’s reports. TSMC’s business kept getting stronger, with a record $46.
news.title_zh: TSMC 一年漲幅達 30% 且距高點下跌 19%：獲利了結，還是加碼買入？
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要TSMC 股價過去一年上漲 30%，但較十月高點下跌 19%，因晶片股在藝卓和英特爾財報後遭拋售。TSMC 業務持續增強，創下 $46 紀錄。

news.summary: Democrats won the mid-term elections, with analysts looking at the political gridlock as a win for markets.

The deal also underscores the arrival of a new big player in that competition: Apollo Global Management, a 36-year-old private-equity pioneer turned private-lending giant. news.summary_zh: 重點摘要Marvell Technology 今日在大選後 AI 拋售潮中再度下跌 14%。Marvell 以股票支付其待定的光學交易，因此其股價每下跌一美元就會損失 $4。

news.title: Marvell agrees to buy Lumentum in $115B stock deal
news.summary: The deal brings together "complementary electrical and optical technologies" needed for connectivity in artificial intelligence infrastructure, Marvell said in a news release.
news.title_zh: Marvell 同意以 $115B 股票交易收購 Lumentum
news.summary_zh: Marvell 在新聞稿中表示，這項交易結合了人工智慧基礎設施連接所需的「互補電氣和光學技術」。

news.title: Marvell Stock Eyes 35% Upside After Lumentum Deal
news.summary: Marvell's stock has collapsed nearly 30% in a month while its own guidance keeps climbing, and the gap between those two lines is exactly where our model's price target lives.
news.title_zh: Marvell 股價在 Lumentum 交易後看漲 35%
news.summary_zh: Marvell 股價在一個月內暴跌近 30%，而其自身財測持續上調，這兩條線之間的差距正是我們模型目標價所在之處。

news.title: Marvell’s $115 Billion Deal Has Lost More Than a Third of Its Value
news.summary: Analysts see Marvell doubling, yet the market is pricing something very different. A fixed exchange ratio with no safety net has turned a premium into a discount, and Lumentum investors are the first to show they doubt the deal.
news.title_zh: Marvell 的 $115 Billion 交易已損失逾三分之一價值
news.summary_zh: 分析師看好 Marvell 將翻倍，但市場定價卻截然不同。固定交換比率且無安全網，使溢價變成折價，Lumentum 投資人首度表達對交易的質疑。

news.title: A $2.4 Billion Fund Bought These 3 Stocks
news.summary: Key TakeawaysHeard Capital, a $2. 4 billion fund, opened new positions in Bloom Energy (BE:NYSE), Marvell Technology (MRVL:NASDAQ), and added 25% to its AeroVironment (AVAV:NASDAQ) stake in the quarter ended June 30, according to its latest 13F.
news.title_zh: 一家 $2.4 Billion 基金買入這些 3 股票
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要根據其最新的 13F 顯示，Heard Capital 是一家 $2。4 billion 基金，在截至 June 30 的季度中，新增了 Bloom Energy (BE:NYSE)、Marvell Technology (MRVL:NASDAQ) 的部位，並增加了 25% 到其 AeroVironment (AVAV:NASDAQ) 的持股中。

news.title: ASML vs. Marvell Technology: Which Artificial Intelligence Stock Is a Better Buy Going into 2027?
news.summary: ASML's near-monopoly on chipmaking lithography and Marvell's AI data push sit on very different rungs of the industry, and their valuations and risks tell divergent stories.
news.title_zh: ASML 對決 Marvell Technology：進入 2027 哪檔 AI 股票較值得買進？
news.summary_zh: ASML 在晶片製造光刻技術的近乎壟斷地位，與 Marvell 在 AI 數據領域的推進，處於產業鏈截然不同的環節，兩者的估值與風險講述了完全不同的故事。

news.title: Is Broadcom Stock a Buy After Marvell's $115 Billion Deal?
news.summary: A rival chipmaker is buying a big laser maker. Is the AI chip giant's stock, around 30% under its record, still worth buying?
news.title_zh: Marvell 的 $115 Billion 交易後，Broadcom 股票值得買入嗎？
news.summary_zh: 一家競爭對手晶片製造商正在收購一家大型雷射製造商。這家 AI 晶片巨頭的股票，距離歷史高點約 30%，仍值得買入嗎？

news.title: Marvell Sinks 7% as Democratic Sweep Hits AI Data-Center Stocks
news.summary: Key TakeawaysMarvell Technology fell 7% today as Democrats’ election sweep hit AI data-center stocks, Celestica included. The election adds policy risk to a stock already weighed down by its $115 billion all-stock deal.
news.title_zh: Marvell 下跌 7%，藍波掃蕩衝擊 AI 資料中心股票
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要Marvell Technology 今日下跌 7%，民主黨選舉大勝衝擊 AI 資料中心股票，Celestica 亦在其中。選舉增加政策風險，令本已因其 $115 billion 全股票交易而承壓的股票雪上加霜。

news.title: Lumentum Fell to $750 With Marvell’s Offer Worth $820. Its November 5 Report Tests the Floor
news.summary: Key TakeawaysLumentum fell to $750 on Monday after agreeing to an all-stock sale to Marvell for 4. 5 Marvell shares apiece, which were worth $820 at Marvell’s price then.
news.title_zh: Lumentum 下跌至 $750，Marvell 收購價值 $820。其 November 5 財報測試支撐位
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要Lumentum 週一跌至 $750，此前同意以 4 全股票出售予 Marvell。每股 5 股 Marvell 股份，按當時 Marvell 價格價值 $820。

news.title: Lumentum Sinks 10% With Marvell as Blue Wave Hits Data-Center Stocks: “Premium Can Quickly Go Negative”
news.summary: Key TakeawaysLumentum fell 10% today as AI data-center stocks sold off after the election, with Marvell and Coherent down too. Marvell is paying in its own stock, so every drop in Marvell’s shares cuts what Lumentum holders get.
news.title_zh: Lumentum 下跌 10%，隨 Marvell 同跌，藍波衝擊資料中心股票：「溢價可迅速轉負」
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要Lumentum 今日下跌 10%，大選後 AI 資料中心股票遭拋售，Marvell 和 Coherent 亦下跌。Marvell 以自家股票支付，故 Marvell 股價每下跌一次，Lumentum 持有者所得便減少。

news.title: Marvell's Deal to Acquire Lumentum Could Be a Game Changer for the Stock
news.summary: Marvell's acquisition of Lumentum will create an optical networking juggernaut.
news.title_zh: Marvell 收購 Lumentum 的交易可能成為股價的關鍵轉折點
news.summary_zh: Marvell 收購 Lumentum 將創造一個光網絡巨頭。
